005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.util.function.BiFunction;
010import java.util.function.Function;
011import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
012import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N1;
013import org.wpilib.math.system.NumericalJacobian;
014import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
015import org.wpilib.math.util.Num;
016
017/**
018 * Constructs a control-affine plant inversion model-based feedforward from given model dynamics.
019 *
020 * <p>If given the vector valued function as f(x, u) where x is the state vector and u is the input
021 * vector, the B matrix(continuous input matrix) is calculated through a {@link NumericalJacobian}.
022 * In this case f has to be control-affine (of the form f(x) + B(x)u).
023 *
024 * <p>The feedforward is calculated as <strong> u_ff = B<sup>+</sup> (rDot - f(x))</strong>, where
025 * <strong> B<sup>+</sup> </strong> is the pseudoinverse of B.
026 *
027 * <p>If f(x, u) is given, B is recomputed at the current reference on every call to calculate(), so
028 * B may depend on the state. If B is supplied, it remains constant.
029 *
030 * <p>For more on the underlying math, read <a
031 * href="https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf">https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf</a>.
032 *
033 * @param <States> Number of states.
034 * @param <Inputs> Number of inputs.
035 */
036public class ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward<States extends Num, Inputs extends Num> {
037  /** The current reference state. */
038  private Matrix<States, N1> m_r;
039
040  /** The computed feedforward. */
041  private Matrix<Inputs, N1> m_uff;
042
043  /** Input matrix, or null if it's recomputed from f(x, u) at the current reference every call. */
044  private final Matrix<States, Inputs> m_B;
045
046  private final Nat<States> m_states;
047
048  private final Nat<Inputs> m_inputs;
049
050  private final double m_dt;
051
052  /** The model dynamics. */
053  private final BiFunction<Matrix<States, N1>, Matrix<Inputs, N1>, Matrix<States, N1>> m_f;
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a feedforward with given model dynamics as a function of state and input.
057   *
058   * @param states A {@link Nat} representing the number of states.
059   * @param inputs A {@link Nat} representing the number of inputs.
060   * @param f A vector-valued function of x, the state, and u, the input, that returns the
061   *     derivative of the state vector. HAS to be control-affine (of the form f(x) + B(x)u).
062   * @param dt The timestep between calls of calculate() in seconds.
063   */
064  public ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward(
065      Nat<States> states,
066      Nat<Inputs> inputs,
067      BiFunction<Matrix<States, N1>, Matrix<Inputs, N1>, Matrix<States, N1>> f,
068      double dt) {
069    requireNonNullParam(states, "states", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
070    requireNonNullParam(inputs, "inputs", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
071    requireNonNullParam(f, "f", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
072    this.m_dt = dt;
073    this.m_f = f;
074    this.m_states = states;
075    this.m_inputs = inputs;
076
077    this.m_B = null;
078
079    m_r = new Matrix<>(states, Nat.N1());
080    m_uff = new Matrix<>(inputs, Nat.N1());
081
082    reset();
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Constructs a feedforward with given model dynamics as a function of state, and the plant's
087   * B(continuous input matrix) matrix.
088   *
089   * @param states A {@link Nat} representing the number of states.
090   * @param inputs A {@link Nat} representing the number of inputs.
091   * @param f A vector-valued function of x, the state, that returns the derivative of the state
092   *     vector.
093   * @param B Continuous input matrix of the plant being controlled.
094   * @param dt The timestep between calls of calculate() in seconds.
095   */
096  public ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward(
097      Nat<States> states,
098      Nat<Inputs> inputs,
099      Function<Matrix<States, N1>, Matrix<States, N1>> f,
100      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
101      double dt) {
102    requireNonNullParam(states, "states", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
103    requireNonNullParam(inputs, "inputs", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
104    requireNonNullParam(f, "f", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
105    requireNonNullParam(B, "B", "ControlAffinePlantInversionFeedforward");
106    this.m_dt = dt;
107    this.m_states = states;
108    this.m_inputs = inputs;
109
110    this.m_f = (x, u) -> f.apply(x);
111    this.m_B = B;
112
113    m_r = new Matrix<>(states, Nat.N1());
114    m_uff = new Matrix<>(inputs, Nat.N1());
115
116    reset();
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Returns the previously calculated feedforward as an input vector.
121   *
122   * @return The calculated feedforward.
123   */
124  public Matrix<Inputs, N1> getUff() {
125    return m_uff;
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Returns an element of the previously calculated feedforward.
130   *
131   * @param row Row of uff.
132   * @return The row of the calculated feedforward.
133   */
134  public double getUff(int row) {
135    return m_uff.get(row, 0);
136  }
137
138  /**
139   * Returns the current reference vector r.
140   *
141   * @return The current reference vector.
142   */
143  public Matrix<States, N1> getR() {
144    return m_r;
145  }
146
147  /**
148   * Returns an element of the current reference vector r.
149   *
150   * @param row Row of r.
151   * @return The row of the current reference vector.
152   */
153  public double getR(int row) {
154    return m_r.get(row, 0);
155  }
156
157  /**
158   * Resets the feedforward with a specified initial state vector.
159   *
160   * @param initialState The initial state vector.
161   */
162  public final void reset(Matrix<States, N1> initialState) {
163    m_r = initialState;
164    m_uff.fill(0.0);
165  }
166
167  /** Resets the feedforward with a zero initial state vector. */
168  public final void reset() {
169    m_r.fill(0.0);
170    m_uff.fill(0.0);
171  }
172
173  /**
174   * Calculate the feedforward with only the desired future reference. This uses the internally
175   * stored "current" reference.
176   *
177   * <p>If this method is used the initial state of the system is the one set using {@link
178   * LinearPlantInversionFeedforward#reset(Matrix)}. If the initial state is not set it defaults to
179   * a zero vector.
180   *
181   * @param nextR The reference state of the future timestep (k + dt).
182   * @return The calculated feedforward.
183   */
184  public Matrix<Inputs, N1> calculate(Matrix<States, N1> nextR) {
185    return calculate(m_r, nextR);
186  }
187
188  /**
189   * Calculate the feedforward with current and future reference vectors.
190   *
191   * @param r The reference state of the current timestep (k).
192   * @param nextR The reference state of the future timestep (k + dt).
193   * @return The calculated feedforward.
194   */
195  public Matrix<Inputs, N1> calculate(Matrix<States, N1> r, Matrix<States, N1> nextR) {
196    var rDot = nextR.minus(r).div(m_dt);
197
198    // ṙ = f(r) + Bu
199    // Bu = ṙ − f(r)
200    // u = B⁺(ṙ − f(r))
201    var B =
202        m_B != null
203            ? m_B
204            : NumericalJacobian.numericalJacobianU(
205                m_states, m_inputs, m_f, r, new Matrix<>(m_inputs, Nat.N1()));
206    m_uff = B.solve(rDot.minus(m_f.apply(r, new Matrix<>(m_inputs, Nat.N1()))));
207
208    m_r = nextR;
209    return m_uff;
210  }
211}
